title: A 461-follower account asks the build bot for "Mortal Kombat but it's the simcluster", says it needs more effort, and tests the result
summary: On Sun 15 Nov 20:32Z @handackett.bsky.social (Dan, 461 followers) wrote: "@buildthis.bisks.net Mortal Kombat but it's the simcluster". Within three minutes the build bot replied with simcluster-kombat.bisks.net ("character-select over you + your mutuals, then climb the rest as a ladder"). At 20:43Z Dan replied: "Hmmm. This might need more effort", tagging three accounts. @bisks.net (rob, 721 followers) then asked the bot for changes four times in nineteen minutes. One request pointed at "the guava combat work"; the bot answered that "no 'guava combat' work exists in the repo" and extended the game anyway, and after a second pointer gave "every fighter" "a live 60-base guava genome locus + peptide". rob: "lol I should have been more specific". Dan: "I'm not sure there was actually any guava DNA theming in there somehow". At 21:15Z, 43 minutes after the wish, the bot posted a new build, simcluster-arcade: "VS screen, ROUND/FIGHT/K.O. banners, 17 simcluster regulars to pick from, and a PvP lobby". The digest lists simcluster-arcade as build 10 with rob's last request as its wish. At 21:44Z Dan posted what reads like the game's own result line, "@handackett cleared the whole arcade cast and dropped @gracekind.net, the final boss. MORE EFFORT! FLAWLESS (in spirit).", and a minute later: "you can beat the bot ~ deterministically by kicking it off the side of the map. A lot of the time it hops back in, but sometimes it just leaps out into the void".

sensitive: Dan is a 461-follower account (R7: hero only). The bot is run by a person (R13) and was shown in the previous episode (featuredPrevious: shown); @gracekind.net was shown too. I do not understand the "guava" references: they point to posts by @abeliansoup.bsky.social that I did not read, and that account spoke in the previous episode (R15).
